measurement.tolerance_rule: max_regression_delta = 2 x the largest per-metric sample standard deviation of the run means, rounded up to 0.01 (minimum 0.01); metrics = mean of the run means
measurement.notes: Model mix over 3 runs: groq:openai/gpt-oss-120b 138, groq:qwen/qwen3.8-27b 102. Measured on integration/gold-set-v3-rebaseline at 32baf85 (spec #22 phases 4-5, #57 Model Pool, review fixes): Gold Set 3.0.0 (83 queries), three Routes (ADR-0003), GRAPH_CONTEXT_IN_PROMPT=off (#47), GUARDRAIL_MASSIVE_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD=0.35 (#48), default LLM_POOL, three sequential `lattice-rag eval --output` runs on 2026-10-28, ephemeral DB, macOS, local ONNX models. No pipeline, judge or provider_degraded errors. The qwen/gpt-oss-120b split comes from qwen's 8k tokens-per-minute limit, not its daily quota, so it is the steady-state mix. faithfulness sd 0.0121 is the widest: 2 x 0.0121 = 0.0242, rounded up to 0.03 (was 0.06 on Gold Set v2's 30 queries). Per-run passed queries 51/54/55. Noul contradiction vetoes (faithfulness 0.0) per run 6/7/7, mostly factoid eval_55/eval_56 and long_context. Route Accuracy before the ADR-0003 collapse: 0.7375 (five Routes, 2026-10-27 default run); after: 0.975/0.9625/0.975 here. The jump comes from the smaller Route set, not a better router. Not comparable with the Gold Set v2 baseline it replaces (means 0.8233/0.8156/0.861/0.8913), which was measured on an arbitrarily assembled 10-Chunk corpus.
